SELECT    'ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION '''||   a||''';'
from(
SELECT    distinct b.sid || ',' || b.serial# a
  FROM v$locked_object a, v$session b, dba_objects c
 WHERE     b.sid = a.session_id
       AND a.object_id = c.object_id
       AND c.owner = 'ELW13');
SELECT c.owner,
       c.object_name,
       c.object_type,
       b.sid,
       b.serial#,
       b.sid || ',' || b.serial#,
       b.status,
       b.osuser,
       b.machine
  FROM v$locked_object a, v$session b, dba_objects c
 WHERE     b.sid = a.session_id
       AND a.object_id = c.object_id
       AND c.owner = 'ELW13';

name: SCRIPT-CONSTRAINT-REPEATED-VALUE-IN-COLUMNS.sql
content:
ALTER TABLE C_INVOICELINE ADD (
  CONSTRAINT CINVOICELINEPRODUCT
 UNIQUE  (M_PRODUCT_ID,C_INVOICE_ID,M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID));


  SELECT C_INVOICE_ID,
         M_PRODUCT_ID,
         M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID,
         MAX (c_invoiceline_ID)
    FROM c_invoiceline
  HAVING     COUNT (C_INVOICE_ID) > 1
         AND COUNT (M_PRODUCT_ID) > 1
         AND COUNT (M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID) > 1
GROUP BY C_INVOICE_ID, M_PRODUCT_ID, M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID
ORDER BY C_INVOICE_ID, M_PRODUCT_ID, M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID;

name: SD-Inv-fact-diff.sql
content:
select *
from m_warehouse

drop table x_i
create table x_i as 
select ad_table_id  ,record_id , sum(totalcost )  amt
from m_itemcard_v
where m_warehouse_id = 1000818
and movementdate between  to_date('01-01-2018','dd-mm-yyyy')  and to_date('31-12-2018','dd-mm-yyyy') 
group by ad_table_id  ,record_id 

drop table x_ff

select *
from c_elementvalue
where name like '%Raw%'

create table x_ff as 
select  ad_table_id  , record_id , sum(amtacctdr - amtacctcr) amt
from fact_acct
where account_id = 1048193
and dateacct between to_date('01-01-2018','dd-mm-yyyy')  and to_date('31-12-2018','dd-mm-yyyy') 
group by ad_table_id  , record_id


select   b.record_id , v.documentno , v.dateacct, dt.name , DT.C_DOCTYPE_ID , i.amt iamt , f.amt famt 
from (select ad_table_id  , record_id from x_i union select ad_table_id  , record_id from x_ff) b
left outer join c_doc_v  v on (b.ad_table_id = v.ad_table_id and b.record_id = v.record_id)
left outer  join c_doctype dt on (dt.c_doctype_id = v.c_doctype_id)
left outer join x_i i on (b.ad_table_id = i.ad_table_id and  b.record_id = i.record_id)
left outer join x_ff f on (b.ad_table_id = f.ad_table_id and  b.record_id = f.record_id)
where abs ( nvl(i.amt ,0 ) - nvl( f.amt,0) ) > 2

content:
/* Formatted on 1/5/2026 3:25:08 PM (QP5 v5.381) */
--1--Creae A table for Previous Year Leave Balance
CREATE TABLE leave_2025
AS
    SELECT l.C_BPARTNER_ID,
           b.NAme           employee,
           l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID,
           v.NAME           leave,
           y.FISCALYEAR     year,
           l.TOTAL_LEAVES
      FROM HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN  l
           LEFT JOIN c_year y ON y.C_YEAR_ID = l.C_YEAR_ID
           LEFT JOIN c_bpartner b ON b.C_BPARTNER_ID = l.C_BPARTNER_ID
           LEFT JOIN hr_employee em ON em.C_BPARTNER_ID = b.C_BPARTNER_ID
           LEFT JOIN HR_LEAVETYPE v ON v.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID
     WHERE l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = 1000138 AND y.FISCALYEAR = '2025'
/*AND em.HR_EMPLOYEE_ID = 1003119*/;

--2--Check The cuurent year data
SELECT l.C_BPARTNER_ID,
       b.NAme           employee,
       l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID,
       v.NAME           leave,
       y.FISCALYEAR     year,
       l.TOTAL_LEAVES,
       l.PRVYEARCFLEAVES
  FROM HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN  l
       LEFT JOIN c_year y ON y.C_YEAR_ID = l.C_YEAR_ID
       LEFT JOIN c_bpartner b ON b.C_BPARTNER_ID = l.C_BPARTNER_ID
       LEFT JOIN hr_employee em ON em.C_BPARTNER_ID = b.C_BPARTNER_ID
       LEFT JOIN HR_LEAVETYPE v ON v.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID
 WHERE     l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = 1000138
       AND y.FISCALYEAR = '2026'
       AND em.HR_EMPLOYEE_ID = 1003119;

--3--Create a bakcup for HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN
CREATE TABLE HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN2
AS
    SELECT * FROM HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN;
--4--Update Privious year baance for current year 
UPDATE HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN l
   SET l.PRVYEARCFLEAVES =
           (SELECT l2.TOTAL_LEAVES
              FROM leave_2025 l2
             WHERE l.C_BPARTNER_ID = l2.C_BPARTNER_ID)
 WHERE     l.C_YEAR_ID = (SELECT C_YEAR_ID
                            FROM C_YEAR
                           WHERE FISCALYEAR = '2026')
       AND l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = 1000138;
--5--Adjust the TOTAL_LEAVES for current year
UPDATE HR_LEAVE_ASSIGN l
   SET l.TOTAL_LEAVES =
             NVL ((l.ADD_LEAVES + l.BALANCE_LEAVES + l.PRVYEARCFLEAVES), 0)
           - NVL (l.USED_LEAVES, 0)
 WHERE     l.C_YEAR_ID = (SELECT C_YEAR_ID
                            FROM C_YEAR
                           WHERE FISCALYEAR = '2026')
       AND l.HR_LEAVETYPE_ID = 1000138;
